result_summary.title: Data residency mismatch and incomplete compliance reports
result_summary.description: While running audits on the Analytics Dashboard in LATAM, we found a mismatch in data residency flags. Some records are marked incorrectly, and this has resulted in our compliance reports being incomplete. Currently, this hasn't impacted live users (0 affected), but it is a blocker for our annual audit. We need the data tagging logic reviewed to ensure residency flags match the actual storage location.
